about.text: Quote-trivia website entered in the 2016 Riot Games API Challenge: identify what triggers a champion's quote, then compare how well others know champions by mastery points (optional League account connection); credits name the developer and a front-end designer; quote text from the community wiki (CC-BY-SA).
